transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm just here because... well, things have been kind of hard lately. I just keep feeling like... like I've really let my family down. We took on this mortgage and... I don't know. It just feels like every small mistake I make at the restaurant... it just proves I'm useless. Like I just deserve whatever happens to me. 

That's... pretty much it.
Have you noticed that you're not enjoying things the way you used to, like hobbies or time with family and friends?

Yeah, I guess. It's just... most days there's this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I just go to work, carry the plates, smile at the customers... but it's just going through the motions because I'm supposed to. I don't really feel anything good anymore. Not even when I'm home.
Have you felt unusually tired or have you noticed a lack of energy most days, even when you haven't been doing much?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I'm on my feet a lot at the restaurant, so I get tired from that. But... I don't think it's anything unusual. Just normal tired, I guess.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, have you felt restless or fidgety lately?

Um... I don't know. Some of the other servers have said something. Like... sometimes I just pace. I'll check the same tables, look at the same receipts, just... over and over. But then other times... it's like I'm moving through mud. Just getting the menus or walking over to punch an order in... it just takes me a lot longer than it used to.
Have you completely lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with loved ones, even when you're not feeling down about work or the mortgage?

I suppose. Um... I just don't really do much anymore. Like, at work, I used to joke around with the regulars a bit. Now I just... keep a straight face. I only say what I have to. 

And... I don't know. My brother texts me after my shifts, but I just let the messages sit. I just don't feel the pull to answer him.
Have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... most days, there's just this... heavy feeling. Like an emptiness in my chest. I just... go through the motions at work. Carrying plates, smiling at tables because I'm supposed to... not because I actually feel anything good.
Have you had trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or have you been sleeping much more than usual lately?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I sleep fine, I guess. I haven't really noticed a change with that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Um... I suppose it's been a bit all over the place. Like... some weeks I barely touch the staff meals. But then... I don't know, other nights I'll get home and just eat whatever's in the kitchen. Just to feel settled, I guess.
Have you had periods like this before, where you felt down or lost interest in things, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
Um... I don't think so. I mean... everyone has bad days, but... not really like this. I think this is the first time.
Have you ever had another period in your life where you felt this same kind of emptiness or loss of interest, even if it wasn’t as bad as this time?
Um... no. Like I said, I... I don't think so. I can't really remember feeling like this before. It's just been lately.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt persistently down, empty, or lost interest in things for more than just a few days?
No. I... I mean, I really haven't. Just what I said before... it's just been lately.
Have you ever experienced a time in your life before this where you felt as empty, hopeless, or disconnected as you're describing now, even for a short while?
I... no. I really don't know what else to tell you. Like I keep saying, it's... it's just never happened before now.

Can you think back carefully—has there ever been another time in your life, even before the mortgage or the restaurant stress, where you felt persistently down, empty, or lost interest in things for more than a couple of weeks?
I... look, I've already answered this. No. There hasn't been another time. I don't... I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing. I've just been feeling it now. That's all.
Have you ever had any other times in your life, even before this current period, where you felt down or lost interest in things for a few weeks, even if it wasn’t as bad as what you’re feeling now?
I... I don't know what else to say. No. I haven't. Just... just what I'm dealing with right now.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for a week or two, even if it wasn’t as bad as what you're going through now?
I don't... I really don't get why we keep going in circles with this. No. I haven't. It's just been this one time.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for even just a few days, not necessarily as bad or long as what you're describing now?
No... I mean, I don't think so. I really don't... I don't know how else to answer this. It's just been lately. That's it.

Before this current period, even going back to when you were much younger, can you recall any time—no matter how brief or mild—when you felt down, empty, or lost interest in things for more than just a day or two?
I... look, I really don't have a different answer for you. No. Not when I was younger, not... ever. It's just now.
